name: Browser QA
description: Open the page in the shared Browser session, check what is visible, and report only failures the page evidence shows.
triggers: check the page in the browser

permissionsRequired.reason: Open the target in the shared Browser session.
Read console and failed requests for this session.
Move to another URL in the same session.
Use a control the check depends on.
Read the session URL, viewport, and screenshot list.

validation.rule: The report cites a browser_screenshot or browser_evidence result from the shared session. HTTP success alone is not treated as a correct UI.
